name: s2k_staticLoadCase
formula: =LAMBDA(name,TEXTJOIN("   ", FALSE, "Case=" & name, "LoadType=" & CHAR(34) & "Load pattern" & CHAR(34), "LoadName=" & name, "LoadSF=1"))
comment: Returns one CASE - STATIC 1 - LOAD ASSIGNMENTS record, fields separated by three spaces: Case=name, LoadType="Load pattern", LoadName=name, LoadSF=1. Argument: name. Case and load pattern share that name. No error branch. Last Update at 2026-11-03.
